com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.com

Interface IAbstractSignalInstance

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ISignalGroupInstance, ISignalInstance

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IAbstractSignalInstance
extends IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable
    The system signals and system signal groups to be data-mapped are represented by a signal instance (IAbstractSignalInstance). ISignalInstance represents a system signal, ISignalGroupInstance represents a system signal group. 'Signal instance' means that the system signal or system signal group is at least referenced by one ISignal or ISignalGroup. System signals or system signal groups which are not referenced by an ISignal or ISignalGroup are not represented as signal instance and so are not available for data mapping.

    • Method Detail

      • getDataMappings

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Set<? extends IDataMapping> getDataMappings()

        Retrieves the data mappings which are referencing this abstract signal instance.

        An IClientServerDataMapping is only returned if the system signal behind this IAbstractSignalInstance is referenced in the role 'call signal'. To get the IClientServerDataMappings that references this signal in the role 'return signal' call getReturnSignalDataMappings().

        Returns:
        The data mappings referencing the system signal / system signal group behind this IAbstractSignalInstance.

      • matches

        @PublishedMethod
ECompatibility matches(ICommunicationElement communicationElement,
                                         boolean expandArraysOfPrimitives)
        Computes an ECompatibility that shows how compatible this abstract signals instance is to a as parameter received ICommunicationElement. Method can be used for mapped as well as for unmapped communication elements and signals.
        Parameters:
        communicationElement - The ICommunicationElement whose compatibility to this should be retrieved.
        expandArraysOfPrimitives - If true primitive arrays (e.g. arrays of uint8) will be expanded so that the array element for each index is matched separately. If false the primitive array will be matched as a whole.
        Returns:
        The ECompatibility between this and the given communicationElement.
